summary: Build partner risk, monitoring, allowability and audit-readiness controls in this practical cross-donor course. Explore the outline.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, oversee, document or audit subrecipient activity across donor-funded projects. It suits people with working exposure to grants, partner finance or programme delivery who need a more consistent approach to partner controls.
audience: Government Project Implementation Unit Finance Officers
prerequisites: Working familiarity with grant budgets, partner agreements or project finance is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use compliance records, case information and spreadsheet-based risk scoring.
